admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Evening reflection journal: settings notice

Entries written in the evening reflection journal are kept for nine days and then removed automatically. The member may read, edit or delete any entry at any time. Entries are visible only to the member; the steward cannot open them.

This setting was chosen by the member on the setup screen and can be changed only by the member, from the journal settings page.

Evening reflection journal: settings notice
